findings.source_quote: suffering at the right hand of God

findings.source_quote: burdened by confidence, comfort, desire, care, and fear with regard to money or food
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “anayelemewa na kutegemea” with “anayelemewa na imani/ujasiri, faraja, tamaa, wasiwasi na hofu kuhusu pesa au chakula” to retain “confidence” rather than “reliance.”
findings.translation_quote: anayelemewa na kutegemea, faraja, tamaa, wasiwasi na hofu kuhusu pesa au chakula

findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “Huenda mke wa Lutu”
findings.source_quote: mustard and fire rain down on Sodom and Gomorrah
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kiberiti” with “sulfuri” or “kiberiti cha manjano” to convey sulfur, rather than matchsticks.
findings.translation_quote: aliponyesha kiberiti na moto juu ya Sodoma na Gomora

findings.suggested_fix: Replace “ya kiungu” with “ya kiasili kisicho cha kawaida” or “ya kimbinguni” to preserve “supernatural,” not “divine.”

findings.source_quote: a seed that had not died bears no fruit and remains alone
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mbegu ambayo haikufa” with “mbegu ambayo haijafa” to preserve the ongoing condition described in the source.
findings.translation_quote: mbegu ambayo haikufa haizai matunda na hubaki peke yake

findings.source_quote: a supernatural hatred and envy must replace our love for created things
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “chuki ya ajabu” with “chuki isiyo ya kawaida” or “chuki ya kimbinguni” to convey “supernatural,” not merely “strange.”
findings.translation_quote: chuki ya ajabu na wivu lazima vichukue nafasi ya upendo wetu kwa vitu vilivyoumbwa

findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “Mungu alitutumia Kristo Mwanawe”
findings.source_quote: God sent us Christ His Son
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Mungu alitutumia Kristo Mwanawe” with “Mungu alimtuma kwetu Kristo Mwanawe.”

findings.source_quote: Lift my eyes from fleshly baubles
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Inua macho yangu kutoka kwa mapambo ya mwili” with “Inua macho yangu kutoka kwa vitu vidogo vya kimwili vinavyovutia” or similar wording that conveys trivial, tempting objects, not bodily ornaments.
findings.translation_quote: Inua macho yangu kutoka kwa mapambo ya mwili
